dataset.title: AMB2025-02 Macroscale Quasi-Static Tensile Tests of PBF-L IN718
dataset.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)
dataset.citation_policy: Use the citation and attribution instructions on the DOI landing page verbatim; do not infer a substitute citation.

related_sources.role: AM Bench 2022 3D-build modeling-challenge description data; candidate calibration reference
in-situ thermography and data-processing scripts for IN718 builds; candidate calibration reference
microstructure measurements for IN718 3D builds; candidate calibration reference
residual elastic strain, residual stress, and part-deflection measurements; candidate calibration reference
serial-sectioning and X-ray CT measurements; explicitly linked by the AMB2025-02 README as the EBSD-related calibration source
NIST AM Bench 2022 challenge-problem descriptions and source links

challenge_context.process: laser powder bed fusion (PBF-LB; NIST title uses PBF-L)
challenge_context.target_definition: Average tensile properties across all eight miniature specimens; exact target field names must come from the official dataset/submission template.
challenge_context.split_policy: Outcome labels for the target parent lineage are held out as one group. Never randomly split the eight sibling specimens and represent them as independent-build validation.

reuse_policy.status_note: Metadata/link only. Dataset bytes are intentionally not copied into this repository until artifact-specific terms, attribution, and local-use permissions are reviewed.
